name: @caotang/import-plottr
description: The Plottr reader for the Plottr import (#290, epic #263): a .pltr outline file — plain JSON — read into folders from the beat tree, scene cards as scenes with the card text as the synopsis, plotlines as scene keywords, characters and places with their custom attributes as codex rows with Details pages, and notes as Research documents; tags as keywords, embedded data: pictures kept and sniffed (Plottr labels PNGs as JPEG). A series file asks for a book; unknown keys are tolerated with a notice. No DOM, no third-party dependency; runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
